big_case.notes: Independent read formed from the record and the outcome: a Fourth Amendment challenge to continuous GPS monitoring of federally-permitted lobster vessels under the closely-regulated-industry doctrine, with four cert-stage amicus briefs, repeat-player petitioner counsel, and a call for a response after the State waived. Doctrinally the question (whether Jones-style property limits constrain Burger administrative searches of mixed-use property) could reach every closely regulated industry, but the vehicle is a single state fisheries rule with a conceded closely-regulated status and a contested preservation record, and the Court denied it silently at its first real conference on 2026-10-05 with no noted dissent. Moderate stakes, below headline.
